projects.title: Explore Pakistan Tours
projects.description: Travel web app to explore Pakistan destinations, tour packages, and trip planning with a clean modern UI.
projects.longDescription: Explore Pakistan Tours is a modern travel web application that helps users discover destinations across Pakistan, browse tour packages, and plan trips with an intuitive interface. The app focuses on clean design, smooth browsing, and an engaging experience for travelers.

projects.title: ZyroFit
projects.description: Modern full-stack ecommerce platform for fitness products with catalog, cart, authentication, and order management.
projects.longDescription: ZyroFit is a complete ecommerce solution built for fitness brands. It includes product catalog browsing, shopping cart, user authentication, and order management. The stack uses Next.js on the frontend and a scalable backend workflow for a production-ready shopping experience.

projects.title: DevOps-OS
projects.description: Personal DevOps portfolio and platform showcasing infrastructure engineering, automation workflows, and cloud-native deployments.
projects.longDescription: DevOps-OS is a personal DevOps-focused platform that highlights real-world work in CI/CD automation, containerization, infrastructure practices, and deployment workflows. It serves as a central portfolio for engineering and cloud-native projects.

projects.title: AI DevOps Agent
projects.description: Intelligent DevOps automation agent powered by Gemini AI that turns natural language into Docker and Kubernetes operations.
projects.longDescription: AI DevOps Agent bridges natural language and infrastructure. Built in Python, it uses Gemini AI to interpret commands and execute Docker and Kubernetes operations. Ideal for automating routine DevOps tasks through a conversational interface.

projects.title: Ride Sharing System
projects.description: Console-based ride sharing app in C++ focused on efficient data structures and algorithms for matching and routing.
projects.longDescription: A console ride-sharing system implemented in C++ with emphasis on data structures and algorithms. Handles rider-driver matching, route optimization, and efficient lookups. Built to practice core computer science concepts in a practical application.

projects.title: Brewista Cafe
projects.description: Full cafe management system with menu, orders, inventory, and reporting using ASP.NET and Oracle Database.
projects.longDescription: Brewista Cafe is an end-to-end management system for cafe operations. It covers menu management, order processing, inventory tracking, and reporting. Built with ASP.NET and Oracle Database to support structured business workflows.

projects.title: Malware Detector
projects.description: Machine learning based malware detection that classifies threats from file features using supervised learning models.
projects.longDescription: A Python machine learning system that detects malware by analyzing file features and behavioral patterns. Uses supervised learning models to classify samples with high accuracy. Built to explore applied cybersecurity and ML workflows.

projects.title: MyFlix
projects.description: Netflix-style streaming app with user/admin roles, secure authentication, and a custom video player.
projects.longDescription: MyFlix is a full-stack streaming platform implementing role-based USER and ADMIN separation, secure authentication with bcrypt and JWT / NextAuth, Prisma-backed data models, and a custom video player. The project demonstrates a polished media experience with modern frontend and backend architecture.
